title: Pre-gate ritual: explainer plus three comprehension questions before gates
subject: pre-gate-ritual
ratio: Before any heavyweight human gate fires - the first git push, the first messenger or notify activation - the epic join MUST produce an explainer artifact plus exactly 3 comprehension questions for the human, and the gate request cites them: nothing is published that is not understood. Reach, stated exactly: this is a standing rule on epic joins that precede heavyweight human gates - it binds the coordinator and the verifier running such a join, whichever identity that is - and the duty lives in the Pre-gate ritual (U4) rule inside ORCHESTRATION.md's invariants section (section 3, Invariants and the risks they neutralize). Its home is the standing, all-agents contract document, the same contract document the verifier-rotation rule (F6, already codified as PR-004) reached, in its own section 4, and the one the planner-only norms of the same audit generation never did; its narrow width is the occasion it fires on, not a narrower class of bound agents. It does not bind ordinary joins that precede no heavyweight gate, and this record does not widen it.

This record codifies U4 alone; U2 is the note-taxonomy record of this same wave; F6 is ALREADY codified as PR-004 and is not re-minted here or anywhere in this wave, and PR-004 is named in the ratio by prose reference only. Flattening U2 and U4 into one record because they share a P-number would collapse two distinct duties, bound at different occasions, into a single ratio. P-017's recorded gate names U4 by name, so the token proves this record's claim and not merely its sibling's. The operator rule the source quotes for this duty is, in the original Spanish, no publicar lo que no se entiende; the ratio publishes the English gloss. The heavyweight gates it fires before are the state.json human_gates entries for network publication and for first webhook activation; that gate list is codified separately in this codification epic and is not restated here. scope_conditions: role:coordinator or role:verifier at an epic join preceding a heavyweight human gate
